both_hands_manual_adjudication.recommended_interpretation_for_root_revi: Exactly the two participating hand owners named by this holding action, not the holder's entire anatomical hand inventory.
both_hands_manual_adjudication.reason: Korean explicitly counts the hands participating in wrapping/holding. Neither language says the holder has only two hands in total, and no human-only intrinsic condition licenses a typical-anatomy inference. The proposed application makes this interpretive scope visible rather than silently changing the body.
both_hands_manual_adjudication.what_guards_prove: Two distinct existing selected hand owners share one existing holder; mug is a distinct contact endpoint. They do not prove no third hand exists.
both_hands_manual_adjudication.selected_effect_scope: Both hand E assignments and mug contact E specify the same participating pair and exact receiver membership at the selected instant. This is not a general hand-total or visible-framing count claim.
both_hands_manual_adjudication.total_inventory_alternative_unresolved: If root reads both as every hand anatomically owned by the holder and exactly two total, these guards are insufficient. Keep that interpretation pending until independent exhaustive inventory/count evidence and an explicit supported source contract are reviewed. No count fact/capability is generated here.
both_hands_manual_adjudication.no_hidden_count_waiver: No participant/subject/count modification or protected contact membership may be hidden by a selector. Any explicit global/visible count meaning in a later source must be separately authored and checked.
